04 / BEFORE MOVING DAY

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Can you help with a same-day move?

The business advertises same-day service. Call or text to confirm crew and truck availability for your date; availability is not guaranteed.

Do you move outside Columbus?

Yes. The original site lists local and long-distance moving. Contact Bruce with your pickup and destination details for a custom quote.

Can I book help without a truck?

Moving labor is available separately from truck-and-labor service. Explain whether you need loading, unloading, or help moving items within your space.

What should I include when asking for a quote?

Your preferred date, pickup and destination areas, home size, stairs or elevators, and any large or delicate items. Share whether you need a truck, packing, or labor only.

Are there extra charges or deposits?

The original site notes that additional time or items may cost extra and some services require a deposit. Ask for the full scope and payment terms before confirming.
